page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance equipped with 96 dedicated vCPUs across 48 physical Intel Xeon 8163 cores running at 2.5 GHz. Utilizing x86_64 architecture and KVM hypervisor management, the system incorporates 372.0 GB of RAM alongside four NVIDIA Turing T4 GPUs providing 64 GB of total VRAM. The instance features no local disk storage, depending instead on external block storage, and delivers a baseline network throughput of 30 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations demonstrate high multi-core efficiency, marked by strong results in stress-ng multi-core execution, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and Redis SET throughput reaching 64.27 million operations per second. Cached small-block memory reads perform at high bandwidth levels, while uncached large-block memory operations remain average. Conversely, single-threaded processing metrics show lower relative output in gzip compression and single-core stress-ng tests.

By combining dense multi-core hardware, 30 Gbps network bandwidth, and quad-GPU acceleration without embedded local disks, the resource profile targets parallel processing density over local disk I/O. This hardware arrangement is suitable for AI model inference, multi-stream video transcoding, parallelized data analytics, and high-concurrency memory-cached web workloads.

Operating on an x86_64 architecture with KVM virtualization, it provides 30 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and relies on remote storage solutions due to the absence of local drives. Benchmark results indicate high multi-core compute throughput, rapid cached memory access, and elevated Redis SET performance, offsetting modest single-core processing metrics. This instance is well suited for machine learning inference, parallel data processing, multi-channel media encoding, and high-concurrency memory-cached applications.
